target.title: fix(secrets): keep startup alive when TTS SecretRefs are missing
target.body:
Closes #101204

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who configured an optional TTS provider API key via SecretRef could have the entire Gateway fail to start when that provider key was missing or empty. In the reported case, a missing `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` disabled Gateway startup instead of only disabling ElevenLabs speech synthesis.

## Why This Change Was Made

The fix keeps built-in TTS provider API-key SecretRefs optional at Gateway startup while preserving fail-closed behavior for required and security-sensitive SecretRef errors.

When an optional TTS SecretRef value is absent, OpenClaw now:

- leaves the affected provider key unconfigured in the resolved runtime config;
- emits a structured `SECRETS_REF_UNAVAILABLE_OPTIONAL` warning with the SecretRef path and resolver error;
- lets Gateway startup and unrelated runtime capabilities continue;
- keeps TTS request failures localized to the selected provider.

Required credentials still fail closed. This PR does not loosen startup behavior for gateway auth, model provider credentials, plugin credentials, channel tokens, invalid SecretRefs, provider allowlist/security policy failures, or resolved values with the wrong shape.

## Review Follow-up / Quality Hardening

This revision addresses the review concern that the first implementation degraded every optional resolver exception:

- optional TTS degradation now goes through `isOptionalSecretUnavailableError(...)`;
- only missing/absent values are downgraded:
  - missing/empty env var;
  - absent JSON pointer path in file provider;
  - missing id in exec provider response;
- policy and contract errors remain fail-closed:
  - provider allowlist denial;
  - invalid SecretRef ids;
  - resolver errors for a different SecretRef;
  - non-string/empty resolved values after resolution;
  - non-`SecretRefResolutionError` exceptions.

## User Impact

Operators can keep optional ElevenLabs or other built-in TTS SecretRefs in config without risking a full Gateway outage when that optional provider key is temporarily absent. Core chat, Gateway auth, other tools, and unrelated plugins remain protected by existing fail-fast credential behavior.

## Evidence

Current PR head is rebased on current `upstream/main` at submit time:

- PR head: `6286e62b91`
- Base used locally for the last rebase: `d8ffb1f307`

Targeted regression coverage added/updated:

- `src/secrets/runtime.test.ts`
  - missing env TTS key degrades to `SECRETS_REF_UNAVAILABLE_OPTIONAL` and leaves the provider key unset;
  - missing file JSON pointer TTS key degrades the same way;
  - provider allowlist denial remains fail-closed;
  - invalid SecretRef id remains fail-closed;
  - non-string resolved TTS key remains fail-closed;
  - required `gateway.auth.token` SecretRef still fails startup preflight.
- `src/secrets/runtime-config-collectors-tts.test.ts`
  - TTS provider API-key assignments are marked optional;
  - inactive TTS surfaces still skip resolution and emit inactive-surface warnings.
- `src/secrets/runtime-discord-surface.test.ts`
  - enabled Discord account voice/TTS overrides degrade when a nested TTS provider SecretRef is unavailable, without resolving inactive base-channel TTS refs.
- `src/gateway/server-startup-config.secrets.test.ts`
  - startup activation accepts optional TTS SecretRef warnings without entering the degraded reload state.
- `src/gateway/server-methods/tts.test.ts`
  - TTS synthesis failures caused by missing provider credentials are returned as localized `UNAVAILABLE` TTS errors.

Live Gateway proof on the current code line:

- Run: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/28848335705
- Proof log excerpt:
  - Gateway started with missing optional `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` SecretRef.
  - Startup emitted `[SECRETS_REF_UNAVAILABLE_OPTIONAL] messages.tts.providers.elevenlabs.apiKey ... Environment variable "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY" is missing or empty.`
  - `tts.speak` failed locally while Gateway stayed up: `TTS conversion failed: elevenlabs: not configured`.
  - Result: `PASS: missing optional TTS SecretRef degraded startup and localized TTS failure.`

Repository CI / security evidence:

- Latest PR CI completed successfully on head `6286e62b91`.
- The previous CI failure was infrastructure-only (`check-lint`: self-hosted runner lost communication). The latest CI run is green for code/security/test gates: `check-lint`, `check-guards`, `check-test-types`, `check-prod-types`, `check-docs`, `check-shrinkwrap`, `Scan changed paths (precise)`, `Opengrep OSS`, `Security High (core-auth-secrets)`, `Security High (actions)`, `Critical Quality (core-auth-secrets)`, `Critical Quality (gateway-runtime-boundary)`, `build-artifacts`, QA smoke shards, and all compact Node shards passed.
- `git diff --check` passed locally before push.
